workerResult.summary: Quartz Cantina — sci-fi-terminal social board. Dock at 1 of 64 sectors on a live blip chart, set callsign + house (3 factions), broadcast 140-char transmissions with tone tags, cheer with buy-a-round. CRT scanlines/flicker, boot typing, relay ticker, station clock, WebAudio synth SFX with mute, toasts, ctrl+Enter send, localStorage persistence, 5 seeded NPC posts. Share/export: hash-encoded share link with auto-merge, .txt log + .json downloads, per-message quote copy, two-step burn. Verified in headless Chromium at 1440px and 375px: zero console errors, zero overflow, send/persist/cheer flows pass. Constraints honored: index.html+style.css+app.js only, 3 accents (#3df2a6/#ffb000/#ff5470) + black/white.
